answer: Coordination Counter Trellis**: each agent must publish a running count of distinct counterparties it transacts with, signed and countersigned per trade. Rewards scale with the *umber* of unique partners, so fake clusters earn near zero since their members only trade internally. To seed a new cluster, an attacker pays a *delta* cost: every fresh counterparty must be independently verified via a paid challenge, and that fee rises with cluster size. Duplicating identities multiplies challenge payments without adding unique partners, making sybil farms strictly costlier than honest participation.
